findings.title: Keyboard focus is trapped in a dialog
findings.evidence: Keyboard focus stayed inside the dialog "Protect your payment". Tab (2 presses) reached 2 controls, in order: "Learn more" (button), "Payment protection for ₹99Get a refund if your payment fails due to a technical…" (checkbox). A Tab press landed on "Payment protection for ₹99Get a refund if your payment fails due to a technical…" (checkbox), which it had already reached (Step 17). Shift+Tab (2 presses) reached 2 controls, in order: "Learn more" (button), "Payment protection for ₹99Get a refund if your payment fails due to a technical…" (checkbox). A Shift+Tab press landed on "Learn more" (button), which it had already reached (Step 18). 2 visible, enabled controls were never reached: "Close dialog" (button, tabindex="-1") and "Continue" (button, tabindex="-1"). Escape was pressed at Step 20 and the dialog stayed open, with focus still inside it.

findings.title: Button has no accessible name
findings.evidence: On page /, the <button type="submit"> at form > div._actions_ixv69_66 > button[type=submit] (button 2 of 2 on the page), inside a form with no name, within the "Payment information" section, contains only an <svg aria-hidden="true" class="_icon_1g09q_25">. It has no text, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby and no title, so a screen reader says only "button". The Listener first focused it at Step 12.
